inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash flow statement, 'Equity settled share-based payment expenses' RMB7,632k (1789.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:8273); no net-share-settlement taxes disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes 0 every year)
inputs.fx_note: HKD per CNY 1.1726 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X on 2026-10-16. Cross-check: USDHKD 7.8472 / USDCNY 6.676 = 1.1754 (0.2% apart). Parity check (no dual listing): the FY2025 final dividend of HK$11.8c/share was booked as RMB112,171k on 1,123.9m shares in the H1 2026 interim (note 14(b)), an implied 1.18 HKD/CNY at the March 2026 declaration date, consistent in direction and magnitude. All flows and per-share values are modelled in CNY and converted to HKD only for the quote-currency outputs.
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,124,616,700 shares issued at 30 June 2026 (interim note 14(a)) less 32,260,000 treasury shares and 15,562,000 shares repurchased for cancellation but not yet cancelled (note 14(c)) = 1,076.8m, plus ~1.25m dilutive effect of options/awards (note 7(b)) = ~1,078m fully diluted. Shares held in trust for the share award scheme (~5m) remain in the count because they are issued and will be delivered to employees. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. Buybacks (RMB208m in H1 2026, ~4.3% of the company) are the reason the count is below the FY2025 diluted 1,119.8m; any post-June repurchases or resale of treasury shares will move this anchor.
inputs.wacc_rationale: CNY-denominated WACC 10.0%: China 10-year CGB ~1.8% + country-risk-inclusive China equity risk premium ~7% x beta ~1.2 for a HK-listed small-cap Chinese medtech = ~10.2% cost of equity; bank debt is RMB5.7m against RMB1.2bn of cash so WACC = cost of equity. No separate ad-hoc premium for VBP policy risk -- that risk is carried in the bear scenario and its 25% weight (charge risk once). Terminal growth 3.0% CNY (below China nominal GDP).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B) leases as operating cost: lease cash (principal + interest; H1 2026 RMB2.6m + 0.1m, H1 2025 RMB7.2m + 0.3m) is charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path at 0.6% of revenue, lease liabilities (RMB7.2m at 30 June 2026) are EXCLUDED from total_debt, and da_pct_path is depreciation + amortisation EX right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: PP&E 83.7 + intangibles 23.2 = 106.9 = 7.2% of revenue; ROU depreciation 14.1 excluded). Leases are immaterial either way.
inputs.nci_treatment: None: total equity equals equity attributable to shareholders (no non-controlling interests) at 30 June 2026 and 31 December 2025.
inputs.net_cash_basis: 30 June 2026 interim balance sheet: cash and cash equivalents 1,078.5 + time deposits and restricted cash 56.5 (time deposits >3m 53.4, pledged 3.1) + wealth-management products at FVPL 110.4 (principal-guaranteed structured time deposits, note 15) = 1,245.4, which ties to the MD&A aggregate of RMB1,245.4m. The RMB4.5m unlisted equity instrument is ignored. Less bank loans 0.949 current + 4.743 non-current = 5.692. Net cash 1,239.7 before the RMB112.2m FY2025 final dividend that was payable at 30 June and paid in July 2026 (deducted in equity_bridge). Interest income (FY2025 26.9m, which includes WMP returns) is stripped from owner FCF because the cash pile is added at the bridge.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing: non-US operating company, with the adaptations file applied for currency, leases and WC sign). AK Medical is an orthopedic implant manufacturer with ~RMB1.2bn net cash, no NCI, immaterial leases and SBC of 0.5% of revenue, so no other route applies. FY0 = FY2025 (revenue 1,482.4; the growth path starts at FY2026, where H1 2026 printed +10.2%). Working capital: a manufacturer/distributor with trade receivables of ~42% of revenue (DSO ~180 days; receivables rose RMB133m on RMB136m of revenue growth in FY2025) and inventory of ~31%, so wc_capture is NEGATIVE (-35% of the revenue change in base). SBC is non-zero (0.5%) so the house/street band exists but is narrow. The price is a regular HKEX close, not after-hours. Buybacks are being funded (RMB208m in H1 2026) so the flat count is paid for, not a convention.

equity_bridge.item: FY2025 final dividend payable at 30 June 2026 (HK$11.8c/share, RMB112.2m, paid July 2026)
equity_bridge.note: H1 2026 interim note 14(b); cash at 30 June still included it (accruals and other payables rose RMB127m)

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 7.4% vs EPS 5yr CAGR 1.3%: FY2020 was the pre-VBP peak (net income 314m) and FY2021 the VBP reset (92.6m); the 3-year series (revenue 12.1%, EPS 18.3%, equity 9.1%) is the post-reset trend. FCF CAGRs are off a noisy base (FY2023 owner FCF was -190m on a receivables build, FY2024 +257m on the release) and are not used for driver selection.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income), RMB m: FY2020 100.5, FY2021 90.4, FY2022 95.3, FY2023 -190.0, FY2024 256.9, FY2025 237.5. Owner and reported FCF CAGRs are close (18.8% vs 18.7% 5yr) because SBC is tiny; the gap is interest income on a growing cash pile. 3-year average owner FCF FY2023-25 = 101.5m, 2-year average FY2024-25 = 247m; the base-case year-1 owner FCF (~320m) relies on the H1 2026 margin step-up (operating margin 28.8% vs 24.1%) and a -35% WC capture on 10% growth.

base.growth_note: FY2026 +10% matches H1 2026 (+10.2%) and FY2025 (+10.1%). FY2027 9% then FY2028 8% absorb a modest price reset at the ~2027 national joint VBP renewal offset by overseas (+42% H1 2026, 24% of revenue) and digital ortho/robotics (+143% H1 2026, 6% of revenue). Decelerates to 3% by year 10.
base.margin_note: FY2025 EBITDA (ex interest income, ex ROU depreciation) ~33%; H1 2026 ~37% on gross margin 63.7% vs 59.1%. Base holds 35% for two years then steps to 34% at the VBP renewal and stays there: the robotics/overseas mix gain is assumed to roughly offset renewal pricing and mass-market competition.
base.capex_note: FY2025 capex 8.4% of revenue with the Changping industrial park and ITI Phase II largely complete; H1 2026 6.4%. Base 7.0% then 6.5%, converging to D&A ex ROU (7.2% -> 6.5%).
base.tax_note: FY2025 income tax 14.2% of PBT, cash tax paid 51.6m (~14% of EBIT); H1 2026 14.4%. PRC high-tech enterprise rate 15% with R&D super-deduction; held at 15%.
base.wc_note: Trade receivables ~42% of revenue, inventory ~31%, payables/bills/contract liabilities ~20%: net working capital ~43% of revenue. FY2025 receivables rose RMB133m on RMB136m revenue growth. Capture -35% of the revenue change.

bull.note: Robotics/digital ortho reaches 10-15% of revenue by 2030 under the January 2026 NHSA pricing guidelines; overseas sustains 25-30% growth on the AK/JRI dual brand; the 2027 VBP renewal is benign for domestic leaders. Mix pushes EBITDA to 38%; DSO improves so WC drag eases to -30%.

bear.note: H2 2026 slows (6% for the year); the 2027 joint VBP renewal resets hip/knee tender prices another 15-20% so FY2027 revenue is flat and EBITDA margin drops to 29% then 28% (the FY2021 reset took the margin from ~41% to ~23%, so this is a partial repeat); spine/trauma keeps shrinking, robotics stays a pilot business, overseas growth halves. Receivables stay stretched (-40% capture). Terminal cap 15x.

scenario_narratives.base: AK Medical compounds revenue at 10% fading to 3% over ten years: domestic hip/knee volumes keep rising under VBP-driven import substitution, overseas (24% of revenue, +42% in H1 2026) and digital orthopedics/K3+ robotics (+143%) offset a modest price reset at the ~2027 national joint VBP renewal, and spine/trauma stabilises at a small base. EBITDA margin holds near the H1 2026 run-rate (35%) for two years then settles at 34% as renewal pricing and mass-market competition absorb the mix gain. Capex normalises to 6.5% of revenue now that the Changping industrial park and ITI Phase II are built; working capital consumes 35% of each year's revenue growth because receivables run at ~180 days. The RMB1.2bn net cash funds the new 55-60% payout policy and buybacks.
scenario_narratives.bull: The January 2026 NHSA pricing guidelines for surgical navigation, 3D printing and robots turn the iCOS platform into a scaled, reimbursed business: robotics and customised products reach 10-15% of revenue by 2030 at structurally higher margins, the AK/JRI overseas franchise sustains 25-30% growth with CE certification unlocking Europe, and the 2027 VBP renewal favours domestic volume leaders rather than cutting price further. Revenue grows 13% for two years and 10%+ through 2030, EBITDA margin expands to 38% on mix, and DSO improvement eases the working-capital drag. Terminal growth 3.5% CNY.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 2027 national joint VBP renewal cuts hip/knee tender prices another 15-20% (a partial repeat of the 2021 reset that halved earnings), FY2027 revenue is flat and EBITDA margin falls to 28-29%; spine/trauma keeps declining, surgical robotics remains a pilot programme as hospitals delay capital purchases and multinationals respond, overseas growth halves, and receivables stay stretched at ~180 days. The business remains profitable and net cash so the dividend survives, but growth settles at 2.5-4% and the terminal multiple is capped at 15x.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear lifted from the 15% default to 25% because ~70% of revenue depends on a single regulator's tender pricing (NHSA VBP) with a renewal round due around 2027, and the FY2021 reset shows how violently that can reprice the business. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs two independent things to go right: robotics reimbursement actually converting to scaled device sales, and overseas growth holding above 25%. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF in CNY, converted to HKD at the quote. Value is dominated by the mature hip/knee implant franchise plus RMB1.2bn of net cash (about a quarter of the market capitalisation); robotics and overseas are the growth optionality and the 2027 VBP renewal is the policy risk, both carried in the scenarios rather than in the discount rate. SBC (0.5% of revenue) and lease cash are expensed in the flows, interest income is stripped because the cash is added at the bridge, and the share count is held flat at the post-buyback 1,078m.
key_risks_to_valuation: 2027 national joint VBP renewal: a further 15-20% price reset is the bear case; the first round cut prices ~82% and halved FY2021 earnings
Working-capital sign and size: receivables at ~180 days consume a third of every yuan of growth; a deterioration in hospital/distributor payment terms would push owner FCF well below NOPAT
Margin step-up durability: H1 2026 operating margin 28.8% vs 24.1% is one half-year; the base case holds most of it
Robotics commercialisation is 6% of revenue growing >100%; the bull case needs it to scale against MicroPort, Chunli and the multinationals
Share-count anchor: treasury shares (32.3m) are held for possible resale and buybacks may have continued after 30 June 2026
CNY/HKD translation: the HKD outputs move with the rate; refresh_price.py does not refresh fx_rate
